name: VestraNES
author: zysilm
punchline: Play NES games in the player, with the keyboard
description: An NES (Famicom) emulator for Vestra Player: load an iNES ROM from Games ▸ VestraNES and its picture and sound play in the player. While the small VestraNES window is in front, the keyboard is the controller: arrow keys, X, Z, A and S; the player's own shortcuts are not affected. Emulation by the bundled open-source library JSNES. No games included.
